dataset_provenance: Assistant-authored questions and source-checked example positive labels; not independently authored, reviewed, exhaustive, or representative. The original pilot is development data. Test questions and out-of-scope examples were written before the v2 comparison. Unlisted entities remain unjudged.
notes: Labels are incomplete and unreviewed; other entities are unjudged. Ranking metrics deduplicate the first six chunks by entity. Timings are warm local search calls, not API or end-to-end answer latency. The probe is only the preliminary similarity gate, not the LLM router. Index preparation may reuse a prior index.

cases.question: Which banking concept represents a deposit account used for putting money in and taking it out?

Which definition connects a household or other customer group to a financial holding?
How is a personal connection, such as a spouse, between two contacts represented?
Which banking object identifies the person or company that holds a payment card?
Which definition connects a financial instrument to the financial holding it belongs to?
What is the general banking concept encompassing loans, investments, and savings held by a customer?
What represents a fixed sum automatically sent from one account to another at intervals?
Which attributes describe a business customer in the common Account definition?
Where can I find first and last name fields for an individual contact?
Which common definition contains the parent account of a business customer?
Where is a contact linked to its parent customer account?
Which definition joins a system user with a team they belong to?
Where are extra postal or delivery addresses for customers and contacts kept?
What represents a work item placed in a queue and links it back to that queue?
What represents a service-level KPI being tracked for an individual support case?
Where is the type of measurement, such as a count or amount, for a goal described?
Which definition counts how often a knowledge article was viewed on a day?
What represents a comment linked to a knowledge-base article?
Which object holds an email signature and its body?
Where is the parent of a business unit specified in the organization hierarchy?
Which common definition contains a system user’s first and last names?
What common object represents a geographic sales region?
